text: Ten minutes ago, this house was one message.

In Pakistan, most families build a home only once. The plan goes back and forth for weeks, one setback mistake gets it returned by the authority, and until it's built, nobody can walk through the rooms.
Naqsha is an agentic home design studio, and every agent in it runs on NVIDIA Nemotron, served by Nebius Token Factory.
One message about your plot and your family, and a setup agent on Nemotron 3 Super fills in the brief, floor by floor.
This plot is in Islamabad, so it looked up the CDA's building rules with Tavily, and Nemotron 3 Ultra turned them into a rule pack that cites its sources.
Already have a plan from your architect? Upload a photo. Nemotron's vision model reads every room, and the design keeps your layout.
Four exterior concepts come back in under a minute. Pick one, or let Naqsha choose.

Nemotron 3 Ultra drafts four floor plans at once from a proven layout. A rules engine checks each against the bylaws, and two fixer agents repair the best ones with tool calls, testing every edit before they keep it. {fix_start} problems, fixed down to zero. All {lda_total} bylaw checks pass.
Then Ultra writes the house in 3D as code, from a checklist of every feature in the concept, and your browser builds it live.
The vision model checks the model against the concept and rebuilds what's missing: from {match_before} to {match_after} percent.
Photos come straight from the 3D model, from every angle. At night, every room is lit.
Then walk through it, room by room, before the first brick.

Anyone can pin a note to the exact spot they mean. Share a link with your family, and they can comment without an account. Here, Ammi asks for a bigger kitchen, and her note reaches the owner right away.

Press Revise. A revision agent on Nemotron 3 Ultra, with nine tools, reads each note, edits the plan, and runs every check again. The window gets wider, and the kitchen gets an island and a longer counter.
You can also just type a change, and it comes back as a new version, checked again.
Ultra plans, fixes, writes the code and revises. Super runs the conversation. The vision model reads drawings and checks the build. All of it on Nebius Token Factory.
Families walk through their home before they build it, and architects bring a checked design to the first meeting. Naqsha is live today, and it's open source.
